name: Berenica's Accessory
desc: Black is the colour of night — a calm, watchful veil drawn over the world. Black is the colour of shadow — a cloak that lets one remain ever near to those they hold dear. Berenica favours it.

name: Flora's Accessory
desc: 芙罗拉[原皮]（待包装）

name: Phantasio's Accessory
desc: A shadow in motion. A fumbling actor on a stage. A tale spun by a fool.

HeadSculpture.name: Portrait: The One Behind the Curtain

name: {nickname}'s Accessory
desc: Drifting through night and sea, in robes of white, to meet the dawn.

name: Lisbell's Accessory
desc: The Elysian Church's doctrine is not merely stitched into fabric — it is etched upon the soul, bearing witness to a girl who time and again sheds her rage, and rises patient and resolute.

name: Lady Nifle's Accessory
desc: Gauzy veils, spun of dusk and aurora, guide each soul across the tear-brimmed river — to the Misty Sea, where all are reborn.

HeadSculpture.name: Portrait: Ferrywoman of the Misty Sea

name: Kezhou's Accessory
desc: Rain slips from flowing robes, gathers at the sword's tip, then vanishes into the world of drifting blades.

name: Su Yi's Accessory
desc: Let dreams soar and pride aloft, with a pinch of cyan, a measure of wit, and a breath of dawn.

name: {nickname}'s Accessory
desc: Drifting through night and sea, in robes of white, to meet the dawn.

name: Fina's Accessory
desc: The nightingale pins snowy plumes to her tale, letting the delicate wings carry her dreams into the clouds.

name: Rebecca's Accessory
desc: Jellyfish tendrils drift into the deep like a trailing hem, setting a lover's heart aquiver in the dark.

name: Eve's Accessory
desc: UI_Skin_Des_2102

name: Tabethe's Accessory
desc: What writhes in the dark — conspiracy, chaos, crime? None of those. Just tentacles.

HeadSculpture.name: Portrait: Demon Tabethe the Red Hand

name: Fushu's Accessory
desc: Wisps of herbal fragrance drift through white sleeves, whispering of life's return to the withered.

name: Lynn's Accessory
desc: Gunpowder warmth clings to the matte uniform — driven on by the pulse of fervent blood.

name: Hilda's Accessory
desc: 希尔妲[原皮]（待包装）

name: Yale and Oliver's Accessory
desc: Burning threads of red and white bind a madman's reveries — and stitch together a boy's innocent dream.

name: Hellfire's Accessory
desc: Chains and thorns mark retribution for sin — and bind the righteous fire that burns within.

name: Camilla's Accessory
desc: A figure limned in luminous grace, every gesture steeped in wine and whispered dusk.

name: Margie's Accessory
desc: A multipurpose helmet forged from a pot — sturdy armour for a scavenger girl.

name: Rhythm's Accessory
desc: Star-flecked blue shimmers across her uniform — a will to protect, and a gaze lifted towards the future.

name: Zhiliu's Accessory
desc: Sunlight spills across sumptuous brocade like molten gold — the dawn of revolution reflected in her golden eyes.

name: Yuming's Accessory
desc: Heaven's thunder courses through his form. Upholding Dafeng's mandate, sin finds no refuge — nor does he.

name: Randy's Accessory
desc: A medal gleams with a genius mind above. A uniform beats the heart of an ordinary man below.

name: Sibylle's Accessory
desc: She wears neither armour nor crown — yet her presence resounds with commanding dread.

name: Truffle and Filbert's Accessory
desc: White plumes flutter through the streets, trailing the scent of malt and hearthfire — borne on the wind to every empty stomach.

name: Outsider's Accessory
desc: Simple garb won't silence the crimson wails of dark alleys — but it shelters a sliver of starlight from the world's brutality.

name: Psyche's Accessory
desc: A butterfly rests in the crook of her arm, bearing dreams that crossed the winter frost.

name: Daphne's Accessory
desc: Verdant green, rising through smoke and gunpowder — light as wild grass, and just as unyielding.

name: The Absolver
desc: The noble angel takes up the sword of judgement. Sinners shall be condemned. The innocent shall be absolved.

HeadSculpture.name: Portrait: The Princess in Bloomfield – Grace

name: {nickname}'s Accessory
desc: Drifting through night and sea, in robes of white, to meet the dawn.

name: Seven-Day Covenant: Lady Nifle
desc: Though miracles have vanished from the world, there are still mortals willing to bear the weight of faith.

HeadSculpture.name: Portrait: Ferrywoman of the Misty Sea – Hymn

name: Volant Viridity
desc: Wings wrought by will, now borne upon the wind.

HeadSculpture.name: Portrait: Miss Jishu Master – Clear Skies

name: {nickname}'s Accessory
desc: Drifting through night and sea, in robes of white, to meet the dawn.

name: Whispers Unspoken: Fina
desc: Shadows adrift beneath the moonlight; the restless whispering among the pages.

name: Promise of Veiled Ocean
desc: The waves soak the hem of her white tulle dress. Upon them rides her whisper: "Only death shall part us."

name: Veils and Whispers
desc: A murmur of love through the silks, an eternity sealed in a fatal kiss.

name: Tidal Repose
desc: Tides to wash away the dust, waves to still the heart.

name: Seven-Day Covenant: Lynn
desc: Though miracles have vanished from the world, there are still mortals willing to bear the weight of faith.

name: Whispers Unspoken: Rhythm
desc: Shadows adrift beneath the moonlight; the restless whispering among the pages.

name: Epulary Elegance
desc: Over wine and words, fates are drawn and fortunes unfold.

name: Sunlit Gristmill
desc: Sunshine gathered, sunshine scattered!

name: Minuet Reverie
desc: Midsummer night, beneath a sky of stars, a forest where violets and butterfly wings waltzed in delicate steps. A sight she had never seen.

name: Starry Hopes
desc: The bell chimes on the year's shortest day, and wishes are entrusted to the night, to be carried on starlight toward tomorrow.

name: Verdant Serenity
desc: Beauty unveiled, grace in its wake.

name: Frosty Fantasy
desc: Why is one of the snowmen so much bigger than the others?

name: Fleeting Traces
desc: Between the bell's chime and turning pages, the years slip away.

name: Rebel Riff
desc: We drink deep on sleepless, velvet-blue nights, whistling as we race into the midnight chill.

name: Black Gospel
desc: Sin needs no hothouse. It blooms in silence, deep within the human heart.
